shots.title: 01_C1打断挥棍_种子1
shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Photoreal live-action Chinese action cinema, 16:9, natural 35mm perspective, realistic human faces, real skin pores, believable weight and body momentum. ONE UNBROKEN LOCKED MEDIUM-WIDE SIDE VIEW; NO cuts or angle changes, natural fluorescent garage lighting with a faint blue practical flash. Characters large enough to see their hands and weapon, but frame ALWAYS includes both people, their feet and the concrete pillar. No captions or logos.

SPATIAL ANCHOR (unchanged throughout): In an empty underground garage, short-haired woman in black motorcycle jacket on SCREEN LEFT facing RIGHT. Bald attacker in dark shirt on SCREEN RIGHT facing LEFT, gripping ONE iron bar in his RIGHT hand. A square concrete pillar stands immediately BEHIND the attacker, further SCREEN RIGHT. Water puddles on the floor. Nobody else is present. Keep identities, clothes, sides, bar and pillar fixed.

00:00.0–00:00.8 [THREAT]: Bald attacker charges one big step LEFT toward the woman and lifts the bar above his right shoulder, ready to swing downward. The bar has NOT swung yet. Woman notices him; her right hand stays LOW until he enters striking distance. He does not hit her.
00:00.8–00:01.3 [INTERRUPT THE ATTACK]: As his bar reaches the READY-TO-STRIKE position, a split second BEFORE any downward strike, the woman suddenly snaps her RIGHT OPEN PALM upward and forward toward his CHEST. This hand raise, not a new gesture, is the power activation. Attack is interrupted in mid-preparation.
00:01.3–00:01.5 [ONE HIT]: A single tiny, very bright blue-white pressure flash erupts from her open right palm and strikes the bald man's sternum. His upper torso recoils instantly on the SAME beat. Never show a continuous beam or a second pulse. The iron bar never comes down.
00:01.5–00:03.2 [FORCED BACK]: The attacker's body travels BACK to SCREEN RIGHT, away from her, two forced stumbling steps with feet skidding on the wet ground. His shoulders remain tilted backward; he has no chance to counterattack. He cannot jump forward toward her or suddenly teleport.
00:03.2–00:04.3 [IMPACT]: His BACK strikes the SAME pillar at screen right; a short dust burst falls from the exact contact point. The bar drops ONCE from his right hand onto the ground. He slides down the pillar, dazed.
00:04.3–00:08.0 [AFTERMATH]: The woman remains at screen left with open palm extended for a beat then lowers it, her fingers trembling slightly. He stays seated against the pillar with the dropped iron bar on the floor. Dust slowly settles. No further blasts, no camera move, no regenerated bar.

MOST IMPORTANT VISUAL CAUSE-AND-EFFECT: (1) attacker raises iron bar to STRIKE, (2) before bar swings woman raises palm, (3) blue flash and chest recoil happen together, (4) attacker moves away to the right and collides with pillar. If simplifying anything, simplify dust first, NEVER sacrifice this timing and direction. Absolutely NO impact on woman; do not make the attacker finish his swing.

overall_soundscape: Fast wet footstep, short hostile inhalation and cloth rustle as bar rises, one dry chest-level pressure thump exactly with palm flash, skidding shoes, one heavy back-to-concrete thud, metal bar clatter, buzzing fluorescent light. No dialogue.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

shots.title: 01_C1_提前反击_种子1
shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
REALISTIC LIVE-ACTION ACTION SCENE, 16:9. ONE CONTINUOUS LOCKED-OFF MEDIUM-WIDE SIDE VIEW, no cuts, no pan, no push-in. Natural fluorescent garage light; real skin, real human momentum. Keep BOTH characters, their hands, the iron bar, their feet and one pillar clearly visible throughout.

FIXED STAGE: Empty underground garage. Woman with short dark hair and black motorcycle jacket on SCREEN LEFT facing RIGHT, her RIGHT palm initially DOWN. Bald man in dark shirt on SCREEN RIGHT facing LEFT; holds ONE iron bar in HIS RIGHT HAND, raised already near his right shoulder. He stands just outside striking distance, ready to attack. A single square CONCRETE PILLAR is two steps BEHIND him to SCREEN RIGHT. No other people. Left/right positions do not reverse.

00:00.00 [START ONE BEAT BEFORE THE HIT]: Bald attacker is ALREADY CLOSE, shoulders coiled and iron bar cocked back over his RIGHT SHOULDER, about to bring it down. He leans aggressively toward the woman. DO NOT spend time showing him running across the garage.
00:00.15–00:00.55 [INTERRUPT]: BEFORE the bar begins any downward strike, the woman rapidly whips her RIGHT OPEN PALM from waist level toward HIS CHEST. This is a defensive counter, not a slow pose. The attacker has not hit her.
00:00.55–00:00.70 [IMMEDIATE FORCE]: The instant her open palm faces him, ONE tight blue-white pressure flash snaps across the short gap and strikes his CHEST. His shoulders and head JOLT BACK on the SAME beat, aborting his attempted swing. NO charging, NO continuous laser beam, NO delay between the gesture and his recoil.
00:00.70–00:02.50 [BACKWARD MOTION]: He recoils and is forced two strong, awkward steps toward SCREEN RIGHT, away from the woman. His wet shoes skid realistically. Keep his body continuous without disappearing or being flung as a stiff horizontal doll. The bar is still in his right hand until the pillar impact.
00:02.50–00:03.40 [SINGLE COLLISION]: His upper BACK hits the same concrete pillar behind him at SCREEN RIGHT. ONE brief puff of concrete dust. He lets go of the iron bar ONCE, which drops beside his feet. His knees buckle and he slides down.
00:03.40–00:08.00 [RESULT]: He remains slumped at the pillar, iron bar on the ground. The woman stays SCREEN LEFT and lowers her open right hand, startled by its power; she does not attack again. Dust settles naturally. No reset, no second hit.

PRIORITY: (1) raised bar about to swing, (2) woman counterattacks BEFORE any downward strike, (3) palm flash and chest recoil synchronized at ~0.6s, (4) victim travels RIGHT to the pillar. Sacrifice dust detail if necessary; NEVER delay the counterattack or reverse left/right direction. No text, captions, titles, or logos.

overall_soundscape: Rustle of raised iron bar, abrupt short WHOOMP exactly synchronized to palm flash, one pained exhale and wet skidding shoes, single back-against-pillar thud and metal clatter. Buzzing fluorescent lights beneath. No speech.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

shots.title: 02_B3落下瞬停_标准时序_种子1
shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Photoreal live-action Chinese urban street, 16:9, a SINGLE UNBROKEN LOCKED SIDE-ON WIDE SHOT, 35mm film look, realistic human anatomy, true gravity and object weight, natural daylight. NO cuts, no zoom, no camera movement, no magic glow, no overlays or text. Lock every person's position and every object relative to fixed sidewalk paving marks.

CAMERA & CAST (all visible at once): Black-overcoat young man SCREEN LEFT, facing RIGHT, his RIGHT hand plainly visible at CHEST HEIGHT silhouetted against a light storefront. Yellow-jacket delivery rider in blue helmet SCREEN RIGHT, holding ONE sealed brown takeaway coffee cup at WAIST HEIGHT in his right hand. The cup, full drop path, sidewalk and their feet are visible, with enough room below the cup to show the cup never touches the ground. In the far BACKGROUND, TWO real passers-by are visibly WALKING before the snap: a woman wearing red carrying a tan tote bag to the right, and a man in a pale grey shirt walking left. They must remain visible after the snap; they do not obscure the foreground cup. No moving cars.

00:00.0–00:00.75 [NORMAL TIME]: The delivery rider holds his cup. BOTH distant pedestrians are clearly taking natural walking steps. The black-coat man's raised right hand prepares a real finger snap: middle fingertip presses firmly against thumb pad, index finger relaxed, wrist steady. Keep the hand visible, not hidden against his black coat.
00:00.75 [RELEASE]: Rider's fingers suddenly let go of the ONE coffee cup. It FALLS DOWNWARD under gravity, straight from its waist-high starting point. His hand stays ABOVE it and reaches downward. The cup is still in the air, clearly separated from the fingers. NO ground contact.
00:00.75–00:01.10 [BRIEF FALL]: Cup descends roughly one handspan (not to the pavement), rider leans forward to catch it, background pedestrians advance one fraction of a walking step. The coffee lid remains attached, cup remains roughly upright.
00:01.10 [ACTUAL FINGER SNAP / GLOBAL STOP]: The BLACK-COAT MAN finishes exactly ONE recognizable finger snap: his middle finger quickly slips from thumb and strikes the base of the thumb; sharp snap sound. At THAT SINGLE INSTANT, the FALLING COFFEE CUP STOPS HARD in midair, approximately mid-thigh height, still well ABOVE the sidewalk. Rider's reaching arm/body freezes in the same pose. BOTH background pedestrians instantly freeze mid-stride in their exact poses. All three frozen figures and cup stop on ONE shared beat. DO NOT finish the fall and do not lift the cup back up.
00:01.10–00:08.0 [TIME ABSOLUTELY FROZEN]: Coffee cup remains completely still at the exact midair XYZ position where it stopped: no sinking, no hovering drift, no movement UP or DOWN, no ground contact. Rider, his clothing, the woman with the tote and the grey-shirt man remain perfectly motionless, frozen mid-action. ONLY BLACK-COAT MAN is alive: he slowly lowers his snapping hand, looks from the floating cup to the frozen rider and takes ONE small cautious step toward cup while everyone else remains frozen. Time never resumes. Fixed camera and same layout through final frame.

GOLDEN RULE: A falling cup STOPPED IN ITS DESCENT is fundamentally different from a cup that hits the ground and rises. There must NEVER be a frame of the cup on the pavement. It must NEVER rise after the snap. Stop ALL background pedestrians and rider at EXACTLY the same instant as the coffee. A correct natural thumb-and-middle-finger snap must be visible, not a point, a wave, a fist, or a finger gun. One cup only; no extra limbs, hands or humans.

overall_soundscape: Normal distant street ambience and steps at first; one sharp audible finger SNAP synchronized with abrupt stopping cup; all street footsteps cut to silence INSTANTLY at that snap. Only black-coat man's own clothes and faint footstep audible after freeze. No music and no dialogue.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

shots.title: 02_B3_近景响指_途中全场瞬停_种子1
shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
REALISTIC LIVE-ACTION URBAN STREET, 16:9. ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT WITHOUT EDITS. Locked camera, slightly angled side view, 28–32mm perspective, DEEP FOCUS in daylight. No zoom, no slow motion, no glowing magic, no text. Entire scene follows ordinary gravity until ONE instantaneous time-stop.

COMPOSITION LOCK: The man in a BLACK OVERCOAT stands CLOSE TO CAMERA at SCREEN LEFT; his RIGHT snapping hand is forward at upper-chest level, unobstructed AGAINST A PALE WALL, visibly large enough to recognize each finger. His black jacket must NOT hide his hand. Delivery rider in YELLOW jacket and BLUE helmet stands in the MIDDLE DISTANCE at SCREEN CENTER-RIGHT, holding ONE lidded BROWN PAPER COFFEE CUP in his RIGHT HAND around waist height. Show the entire falling path and pavement BELOW the cup. Two clearly visible walking passers-by are behind the rider: woman in RED jacket with beige tote, walking RIGHT; man in LIGHT GREY top, walking LEFT. All FOUR people and the cup appear in the SAME fixed shot. The rider does not block the cup. Background walkers must remain in frame throughout.

00:00.00–00:00.25 [NORMAL]: The two passers-by are walking naturally. Rider is holding the coffee. Man in black is about to snap: RIGHT MIDDLE FINGERTIP pressed hard against RIGHT THUMB PAD, hand held in clear silhouette against the pale wall, NOT pointing. Keep his index finger relaxed.
00:00.25 [ACCIDENT]: The coffee slips from rider's fingers and visibly starts FALLING DOWN under gravity, lid attached. The empty rider's hand remains ABOVE the cup and starts reaching DOWN. Background people continue their walking steps.
00:00.25–00:00.60 [FALL IN PROGRESS]: The cup drops a short visible distance, still WELL ABOVE the sidewalk; it has NOT reached the ground. The rider bends in pursuit. Two walkers continue moving. The man's thumb and middle finger are still loaded for the snap.
00:00.60 [ONE REAL FINGER SNAP = GLOBAL STOP]: A recognizable snap of the BLACK-COAT MAN'S RIGHT HAND: the middle finger SLIDES FAST OFF THE THUMB and STRIKES THE FLESHY BASE of the thumb. It makes ONE crisp snap sound. IN THE VERY SAME INSTANT the cup STOPS DEAD WHILE DESCENDING ABOVE THE PAVEMENT; the rider freezes reaching for it; both background pedestrians FREEZE MID-STRIDE, with their suspended limbs and handbag stopping too. ALL freeze simultaneously. Nobody lifts or catches the cup.
00:00.60–00:08.00 [HOLD THE SAME FRAME GEOMETRY]: The one coffee cup stays suspended at EXACTLY THE HEIGHT AND IMAGE LOCATION reached at the snap, never touching the sidewalk, never moving up. Rider and BOTH background pedestrians remain absolutely fixed in their snapped poses; no walking, no blinking, no drifting feet, no moving handbag. ONLY the man in black is allowed to move: he lets his hand relax, turns his head slowly to verify the three frozen people and takes ONE tiny step, then stops. Camera does not move.

FAILURE CONDITIONS: cup lands then rises = FAILURE; cup descends after snap = FAILURE; a pedestrian keeps walking = FAILURE; snap hand merely points or waves = FAILURE. The cup is frozen MID-FALL, not levitating upward. No duplicate cups, no sudden cuts, no extra hands or people.

overall_soundscape: Short daytime traffic ambience, faint footsteps; ONE crisp close finger snap at 00:00.60; all environmental sound and passers-by steps immediately cease. Only the man in black makes a soft fabric movement and one quiet footstep. No music or dialogue.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

shots.title: 03_B3_冻结保持诊断_首帧悬停_种子1
shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
PHOTOREAL LIVE-ACTION TIME-STOP STATE TEST, 16:9. SINGLE TRIPOD LOCKED-OFF DEEP-FOCUS MEDIUM-WIDE SHOT, no cuts, camera motion, slow motion, camera zoom, CGI glow or text. Real Chinese street, flat pale shopfront and grey paving slabs; visible stable lines in the paving to prove objects do NOT shift position.

IMPORTANT: THE WORLD IS ALREADY FROZEN IN THE FIRST FRAME. This tests whether H3 can MAINTAIN a stopped physical state, not the triggering snap. There is NO fall, NO finger-snap and NO lift in this diagnostic shot.

PERMANENT VISUAL ARRANGEMENT FROM 00:00.00 TO 00:08.00: Young man in BLACK OVERCOAT at SCREEN LEFT facing RIGHT. Rider in YELLOW jacket and BLUE helmet at SCREEN RIGHT is FROZEN leaning forward to catch a dropped drink; his right fingers are above the cup. ONE BROWN PAPER COFFEE CUP is already suspended IN MID-AIR in front of him, lid horizontal, bottom roughly at his knee level, clearly far ABOVE the pavement. Coffee never contacts the ground. Behind them woman in RED jacket with BEIGE tote bag is FROZEN MID-STRIDE moving right, one heel raised; man in LIGHT GREY top is FROZEN MID-STRIDE moving left, one foot elevated. Show all three frozen people and the cup throughout. No cars or other moving things.

00:00–00:02: Everything is already frozen in EXACTLY its starting position. Only black-overcoat man moves his EYES to the suspended cup.
00:02–00:05: Only black-overcoat man turns his HEAD toward the frozen pedestrians and shifts his shoulders slightly. All other human bodies, hands, heads, eyes, clothing, tote bag, coffee cup, lid and feet hold precisely the SAME positions relative to shopfront and pavement.
00:05–00:08: Only black-overcoat man takes ONE SMALL slow step closer, then stops. The one cup still hovers at its ORIGINAL height and place. Rider and the two passers-by remain frozen like statues. No time restart.

NON-NEGOTIABLE: Not a cup rising from the pavement; the cup is ALREADY suspended from the first frame and NEVER MOVES. NO person besides the man in black moves even slightly. Do not add any other people, cups, gestures, snapping, cuts or jumps. This is a deliberate FREEZE-STABILITY DIAGNOSTIC, not the finished continuous sequence.

overall_soundscape: Utterly still silent urban ambience; only the black-coat man's clothing creak and one quiet step are audible. No dialogue or music.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
